parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1). It is both the plan lookup key AND the associate scope: activeHeads counts only assignments whose associate has an active (not-ended) shift at that site (ADR 0034, ADR 0035). It must have facility-layout's Site code format (uppercase letters and digits, its SiteCode pattern); anything else is 400 invalid-site-code. Existence is never checked against facility-layout: an unknown but well-formed code simply counts 0.

parameters.name: shiftId
parameters.description: The shift (within the site) whose committed plan to read.
